implementation.name: openfpga-genesis (Analogue Pocket, opengateware)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): open -- the repository carries 120 HDL source files (18 systemverilog, 87 verilog, 15 vhdl). There is no open_source column in the delivered schema (data-model.md §1.9 deleted the proposed core table together with its flags); the presence of hdl_language_id and of implementation_path rows is how that fact is stated here. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not setname-derived -- this core ships no MRA file. It reimplements the Sega Mega Drive / Genesis, giving machine_id genesis, each checked against extract/machine.json. license_id omitted: the repository has no LICENSE, LICENCE or COPYING file at its root and no licence grant was found in the HDL headers read (src/fpga/apf/apf_top.v, src/fpga/apf/common.v, src/fpga/apf/io_bridge_peripheral.v). hdl_language_id: no single HDL family reaches 90% of the 120 source files (18 systemverilog, 87 verilog, 15 vhdl), excluding the shared framework directory. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. Core identity read from the openFPGA manifest dist/Cores/ericlewis.Genesis/core.json in the repository, which declares core identifier ericlewis.Genesis.

implementation_dependency.note: JT12 YM2612/YM2203 core vendored at src/fpga/core/rtl/jt12/jt12_top.v
JT89 SN76489 core vendored at src/fpga/core/rtl/jt89/jt89.v
